meaning: A feeling of great happiness.

meaning: The feeling of being happy.

meaning: The feeling of being unhappy.

meaning: A feeling of wanting what another person has.

meaning: Very deep sadness, especially when someone dies.

meaning: Feeling sad or upset because of what someone said or did.
example: I was hurt when he did not invite me.

meaning: Happy and satisfied about something.

meaning: Unkind and unfair to other people.

meaning: Kind and showing concern for other people.

meaning: Showing love and care for others.
example: My grandmother is a loving and gentle woman.

meaning: To laugh in a silly way with small sounds.

meaning: To smile widely.

meaning: To cry loudly with short breaths.

meaning: To cry because you are very sad.

meaning: To not like someone or something.

meaning: To respect and like someone for what they do.
example: I admire my mother for working so hard.

meaning: To make someone laugh or smile.

meaning: Very surprised in a good way.

meaning: Not joking; thoughtful and not playful.

meaning: Having good sense and knowing what is right.

meaning: Not showing good sense.

meaning: Having no worries or problems.

meaning: To feel angry and bitter about something unfair.

meaning: Hurt or upset by something rude someone said.

meaning: Confused because you cannot understand something.

meaning: Very interested and eager to do something.

meaning: A gentle feeling of liking and love for someone.

meaning: A strong wish for something or someone.

meaning: A feeling of sadness and no hope.

meaning: Great unhappiness or suffering.

meaning: Pleased because you got what you wanted.
example: The customer was satisfied with the service.

meaning: To love and admire someone very much.

meaning: To strongly dislike someone or something.

meaning: A tendency to become angry quickly.
example: He has a bad temper and shouts a lot.

meaning: To make someone feel annoyed.

meaning: To make someone feel upset because they cannot succeed.

meaning: To make someone calmer or less upset.
example: Soft music helps soothe a crying baby.

meaning: To comfort someone who is sad or disappointed.

meaning: To say something to remove someone's worry.

meaning: To make someone want to do something.

meaning: To make someone lose hope or confidence.

meaning: To make someone feel shy or ashamed in public.

meaning: A strong feeling of dislike for something unpleasant.

meaning: To surprise someone suddenly and a little frighten them.

meaning: To please someone by being nice and attractive.

meaning: Full of energy and ready to do things.

meaning: Feeling sleepy and not fully awake.

meaning: Not caring about danger or what may happen.

meaning: Funny and making people laugh.

meaning: A deep feeling of sympathy and wish to help.

meaning: Kindness shown by not punishing someone.
example: The judge showed mercy to the young offender.
exampleTamil: நீதிபதி அந்த இளம் குற்றவாளியிடம் கருணை காட்டினார்.

meaning: A warm liking for someone or something.
example: He has a special fondness for his old school.
exampleTamil: அவனுக்குத் தன் பழைய பள்ளியின் மீது தனிப் பிரியம் உண்டு.

meaning: A strong feeling that someone is worthless.
example: She looked at the cheater with contempt.
exampleTamil: அவள் ஏமாற்றுக்காரனை அவமதிப்புடன் பார்த்தாள்.

meaning: Very strong and uncontrolled anger.
example: He shook with fury when he saw the broken window.
exampleTamil: உடைந்த ஜன்னலைப் பார்த்ததும் அவன் கடும் சீற்றத்தில் நடுங்கினான்.

meaning: To hate someone or something very much.
example: I loathe getting up early on cold mornings.
exampleTamil: குளிர்ந்த காலையில் சீக்கிரம் எழுவதை நான் கடுமையாக வெறுக்கிறேன்.

meaning: To dislike something very strongly.
example: She detests dishonest people.
exampleTamil: அவள் நேர்மையற்றவர்களை அறவே வெறுக்கிறாள்.

meaning: To hold on tightly to someone or something.
example: The frightened child was clinging to his mother's hand.
exampleTamil: பயந்த குழந்தை தன் அம்மாவின் கையை இறுகப் பற்றிக்கொண்டிருந்தது.

meaning: To feel sad and not want to do anything.
example: He moped around the house after failing the test.
exampleTamil: தேர்வில் தோற்ற பிறகு அவன் வீட்டில் சோகமாகச் சுற்றிக்கொண்டிருந்தான்.

meaning: To worry too much about small things.
example: Do not fret over things you cannot change.
exampleTamil: மாற்ற முடியாத விஷயங்களுக்காக அதிகமாகக் கவலைப்படாதே.

meaning: To think about something sad again and again.
example: She kept brooding over the argument all week.
exampleTamil: அவள் வாரம் முழுவதும் அந்தச் சண்டையை நினைத்து மனதிற்குள் குமுறினாள்.

meaning: To let out strong feelings, especially anger.
example: He vented his anger by going for a long run.
exampleTamil: அவன் நீண்ட ஓட்டத்தின் மூலம் தன் கோபத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தினான்.

meaning: To make someone feel very ashamed in front of others.
example: The teacher should never humiliate a student in class.
exampleTamil: ஆசிரியர் வகுப்பில் எந்த மாணவனையும் அவமானப்படுத்தக் கூடாது.

meaning: To shock someone very much.
example: The terrible news horrified the whole village.
exampleTamil: அந்தக் கொடூரமான செய்தி ஊர் முழுவதையும் பெரும் அதிர்ச்சியடையச் செய்தது.

meaning: To fill someone with delight and wonder.
example: The beautiful garden enchanted all the visitors.
exampleTamil: அழகிய தோட்டம் வந்த எல்லோரையும் மயக்கியது.

meaning: Very confused and not sure what to do.
example: The bewildered tourist could not find the station.
exampleTamil: திகைத்துப்போன சுற்றுலாப் பயணியால் நிலையத்தைக் கண்டுபிடிக்க முடியவில்லை.

meaning: Unable to understand something at all.
example: The doctors were baffled by her strange illness.
exampleTamil: அவளின் விசித்திர நோயால் மருத்துவர்கள் புரியாமல் குழம்பினர்.

meaning: Not showing interest or caring about anything.
example: Many young voters feel apathetic about politics.
exampleTamil: பல இளம் வாக்காளர்கள் அரசியலில் ஆர்வமற்று இருக்கிறார்கள்.

meaning: Too ready to believe what others say.
example: Gullible people often fall for online scams.
exampleTamil: எளிதில் ஏமாறுபவர்கள் இணைய மோசடிகளில் அடிக்கடி சிக்குகிறார்கள்.

meaning: Refusing to obey rules or authority.
example: He was a rebellious teenager who hated rules.
exampleTamil: அவன் விதிகளை வெறுத்த எதிர்ப்புக் குணமுள்ள இளைஞன்.

meaning: Able to control yourself and follow rules.
example: She is a disciplined student who studies every day.
exampleTamil: அவள் தினமும் படிக்கும் ஒழுக்கமுள்ள மாணவி.

meaning: Having made a firm decision not to give up.
example: He is determined to pass the exam this year.
exampleTamil: அவன் இந்த ஆண்டு தேர்வில் தேர்ச்சி பெற உறுதியாக இருக்கிறான்.

meaning: Willing to listen to new ideas.
example: A good leader is open-minded and listens to others.
exampleTamil: நல்ல தலைவர் திறந்த மனதுடன் மற்றவர்களின் பேச்சைக் கேட்பார்.

meaning: Not willing to accept different ideas.
example: It is narrow-minded to judge people by their clothes.
exampleTamil: ஆடையைப் பார்த்து மக்களை மதிப்பிடுவது குறுகிய மனப்பான்மை.

meaning: Deep sorrow for something wrong you have done.
example: He felt great remorse for lying to his parents.
exampleTamil: பெற்றோரிடம் பொய் சொன்னதற்காக அவன் மிகவும் வருந்தினான்.
